evidence_scope: measured metadata and first-party source inspection plus deterministic derived arithmetic; no weights, CUDA, provider, or quality run

accounting.representation: AWQ-style W4, group_size=128, zero_point=true, packed INT4; no tile padding because all listed K/N satisfy Marlin constraints
accounting.formula_per_quantized_weight: 0.5 packed INT4 byte + 2.0 FP16 scale bytes / group + 0.5 packed 4-bit zero-point bytes / group

kv.fp8_layout: one FP8 byte per K/V scalar plus inline FP32 scale per token-head

accounting.fit_interpretation: c16 fits with 7.966 GiB BF16-KV slack at primary and 6.910 GiB slack at 10K explicit FP8-KV; c32 fails primary BF16-KV but fits explicit FP8-KV. No allocator measurement was performed.

bandwidth_bound.interpretation: This is a weight-streaming ceiling, not endpoint throughput: it excludes launch, compute, attention, scheduling, prefill overlap, and quality.

consumer_audit.consumer: first-party vLLM AutoAWQ/AutoGPTQ -> Marlin WNA16 CUDA linear consumer

support.formats: AWQ uint4 with runtime zero-points or GPTQ symmetric uint4b8
support.tile_restrictions: N divisible by 64 and K divisible by 128; tile padding allowed for non-act-order layers; group boundaries must divide partition K
support.workspace: runtime Marlin workspace allocated by marlin_make_workspace_new

consumer_audit.checkpoint_route: none: no exact-revision W4 producer/checkpoint metadata exists; source audit proves only a synthetic checkpoint-free component proxy, not an exact quality-preserving route

nomination.reason: Economic and c16 capacity gates pass, but no exact target-revision W4 producer/checkpoint route or authorized actual CUDA execution-equivalent result is bound. Do not promote source arithmetic alone.

uncertainties: No CUDA execution, kernel timing, allocator telemetry, numerical oracle, raw output, or feature quality gate.
Marlin workspace and transformed-checkpoint padding are runtime-dependent; 5 GiB is inherited conservative allowance, not measured W4 allocation.
Zero-point accounting assumes packed 4-bit zeros at 0.5 byte/group; wider producer storage increases bytes.
No quality transfers from BF16 or community quantized checkpoints.
